lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gills. Centroids exhibit increasing spatial separation along the longitudinal axis towards the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient with highlights on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 6-8 visible high-luminance spots, distributed unevenly across the leading and middle sections of the fin's lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A transition in patterning from high-density, small-diameter spots on the cranial region to larger, widely-spaced centroids on the main trunk.
